{{Quote|There's more at play here than you can guess and my master wants the Mandos out of it.|Yaga Auchs to Hondo Karr|<ref name="Legacy 41" />}}
'''Yaga Auchs''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who fought during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. However, he was loyal not to the rightful [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Chernan Ordo]], but to a [[Yaga Auchs' master|third party]] who wanted the Mandalorians out of the war.<ref name="Legacy 41" />

After betraying [[Hondo Karr]] and Ordo at the [[Battle of Botajef]], Auchs took command of the remaining Mandalorian forces. As a result, he claimed the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] for himself and kept the Mandalorians out of the rest of the war.<ref name="Legacy 41" />

At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Auchs was still in control of the Mandalorians. But unknown to him, Hondo Karr was still alive. After reuniting with [[Tes Vevec|his ex-wife]], Karr returned to the Mandalorians, intending to bring Auchs to justice as well as exact his revenge upon the treacherous Mandalore.<ref name="Legacy 41" />
